scope: One paired serial08then35 discriminator, naturally Restricted q2/depth6/tail8 and identical prospective caps. Common recordedforest/oracle where practical. Same complete callee inputs/effects; no matcher/window/queue/cap sweep, PGO or qualification.

assuranceLimits.localOracle: score/retained/PV/N/R/stat deltas; independent shared-state comparison at root-candidate final boundary only
assuranceLimits.transientEffects: an erroneous transient write later overwritten may escape independent audit; native replay/commit source proof and focused direct-state controls support this finite discriminator
assuranceLimits.rollbackEvidence: private-stage construction invariant plus focused before/after controls; not independently full-state checked on every native rejection
assuranceLimits.entryIdentity: complete actual callee/site/variant/Node/history/request/predecessor/supplied-scratch and epoch; ancestor administrative site chains need not match
assuranceLimits.adoption: not production approval; strengthen local-effects auditing before adoption or oracle removal

comparisonOrder: complete-order first on even tail turns, consumed-prefix first on odd turns

certificate.fallback: full order on higher depth/Q/incomplete/capped/ambiguous evidence
